title.narrative: In 2024, as more PICT governments made political commitment for multi-sectoral response to all forms of malnutrition, UNICEF helped define the vision, road map, and priority intervention packages to translate the commitments into actions. In Fiji, following the dissemination of UNICEF-commissioned Food Systems and Nutrition study at multisectoral stakeholder workshop, a comprehensive legal landscape analysis in support of front of pack nutrition labelling (FOPNL) introduction was initiated. Multi-sectoral workshops also took place in FSM and RMI, which helped identify priority actions in each sector. Comprehensive dietary intake assessment, food systems mapping, followed by development of evidence-based, context-specific dietary guidelines were common interventions to be supported across PICTs, which started in RMI, FSM, Cook Islands and Niue.
